summary: Quhuo Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a Nasdaq Hearings Panel decision granting continued listing subject to conditions: file to transfer to Nasdaq Capital Market by May 26, 2026, disclose no external financing for one year, and no securities issuance through September 23, 2026. The company completed a 1-for-30 reverse ADS split on April 27, 2026, and regained bid price compliance. Trading remains suspended pending conditions. This is a routine listing compliance update with no transaction, shareholder vote, or special situation event.
